NO_FALLBACKS.policy: STRICT - No .get() with defaults on critical data
NO_FALLBACKS.rationale: Fail fast, fail loud - financial systems must not silently degrade
NO_FALLBACKS.enforcement: Direct dict access with explicit 'if key in dict else' for optional data

strategy_independence.principle: S/R calculation independent of active strategy
strategy_independence.implementation: SRCalculator uses 'comprehensive_analysis' mode, returns ALL levels

prediction_engine.when: Analyzes market structure, predicts future setups

position_sizer.responsibility: Calculate position sizes for ALL engines

unified_pipeline: PredictionEngine → Filter S/R by strategy, generate predictions
ReactiveEngine → Detect momentum, execute market orders
Both engines → PositionSizer → Calculate size → Place order

rr_refactor.change: R:R no longer hard constraint for TP placement
rr_refactor.before: Filtered S/R levels by R:R, rejected valid levels
rr_refactor.after: Accept ALL S/R levels, use R:R for position sizing
rr_refactor.impact: No more 'No valid TP target' errors

position_sizing.change: Balance-aware position sizing with R:R scaling
position_sizing.after: Dynamic: balance × position_size% × rr_multiplier × leverage / price

circular_dependency.change: Strategy selection independent of S/R levels
circular_dependency.before: StrategyManager used S/R proximity → circular dependency
circular_dependency.impact: Each strategy gets correctly filtered S/R levels

TradingPrediction.required: ALL fields must be present (NO FALLBACKS)

MomentumSignal.required: ALL fields must be present (NO FALLBACKS)

unified_data.validation: All keys must exist, raise KeyError if missing

tp_adaptive_config.note: min_rr/max_rr are GUIDELINES for mathematical TP fallback, not filters
